description: Autonomous Region of Friuli Venezia Giulia publishes the artificial-water-network layer used for defining minimum environmental flow (DMV) under the regional water-protection plan. Dataset and service metadata refer to the same named layer. Coverage is Friuli Venezia Giulia. This explicitly engineered water network can provide topology context for water network flow simulations. The grouped resource has 2 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The service metadata links CC BY 4.0, while the dataset says only public data; exact distribution-specific reuse terms remain qualified. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. The short abstract cites an annex of the plan without specifying capacities, operational flows or hydraulic parameters. The related natural-river flow layers have not been assumed to be infrastructure data. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2018-02-07 to 2018-02-07; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
